answer: Re-attestations are stored in echo and atlas lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the forge graph. Verification costs 11 dollars and 6 days per identity, which turns a 975 account sybil into a 9 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
